summary: Second Creator wonder is actually enacted after legitimate existing D554 consultations. No repetitive reports, city arcano-technological transformation, one existing airport expanded into unified Base Aurora and Campo da Legião complex. 19 core protective systems may be installed with consent and tests; Protocolo Último Horizonte explicitly deferred for future approval. Reintroduce Maelis, medical leader/healer with historically developed affection/relationship with Varo, missing from recent chapters because of narrative omission not canonical absence. Preserve Maelis agency, hospital patients/Reva/Ysol/Rumo and human aftermath. Wider world autonomous/physical travel; GÊNESE full.

Existing airport ramps/hangars/pilot operations remain; central majestic tower, circular original city insignia, forest and water only compatible with site survey and no involuntary displacement
Aegis urban and regional invisible multilevel shields replace emergency only once new operating; cover farms and settlements of free-city geographic perimeter with breathable air/traffic/ecosystems
Tridente anti-vehicle/perimeter turrets operated remotely from safe control zones, adequate human authorization and no targeting of civilians
Automated protection, citywide magical/technological transformation, meaningful on-page creation not endless planning
All major proposed 20 defense systems honored in progression; system #19 Last Horizon remains unbuilt, unapproved, sealed as a concept pending future decision
Maelis direct medical protagonist; emotional history with Varo shown without inventing retroactive day-by-day actions during Ithran's war
No new flying ARGOS/ASA LIVRE certification without flight
Derel-to-Serakh by real route, Neris and dwarf envoy actual travel only
note: New directive supplements prior approved author proposal, supersedes previous expectation to delay most construction, applies to future narrative only. Source author's text is the approval for early implementation excluding #19.
